Changing and shower facilities are available. Routes pass through Schloss Senden, along the canal and through Königspark; there is a good supply of cake, drinks and hot food; the event can take place in any weather.

name: Waldlauf
location: Remsecker Waldlauf, Hochdorfer Wald, Büchenbach, Bayern, Germany
description: The Remseck Forest Run is a family-friendly race through the picturesque Hochdorf Forest, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers a range of distances, from a Bambini run and children’s and youth races to short, middle- and long-distance races. The varied forest trails, with muddy, uneven ground and small obstacles, make the race a memorable and adventurous experience. The run is organized by Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and places great importance on community and experiencing nature.
course_highlights: All routes lead through the beautiful Hochdorf Forest
Muddy, uneven ground and narrow trails with small obstacles
A variety of distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Race number collection: Friday, 16:30–18:00, and Saturday from 9:30. Each participant receives a race number with an integrated chip. Recycled technical shirts can be ordered online as an option until 05.09.2026 (children €15, adults €20). Late registration is possible on the event day until 60 minutes before the start; the late registration fee is €3.

name: Wuppertaler Löwenlauf
description: The Wuppertal Löwenlauf is an exciting running event taking place on November 14, 2026, in Wuppertal. Organized by Leichtathletik-Verband Nordrhein e.V., the race offers a challenging cross-country or forest course in a natural setting. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and promises a sporting experience in a motivating atmosphere. It is a great opportunity to experience the running community in Wuppertal and enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Cross-country/forest run in a natural setting
Challenging terrain for different ability levels
Outdoor event in Wuppertal in November
additional: The race is a forest and cross-country event; details about course distance and registration are not specified.

name: Zeiler Waldmarathon
location: Zeil am Main, Haßberge, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Zeil Forest Marathon takes place on 14 November 2026 in Zeil am Main and offers challenging running routes through the Haßberge Nature Park. The course runs mainly along paved forest paths, following a varied route over Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe and past several lakes. Events include the marathon, half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking over 21.1 km and 7.5 km. The event is organised by TV 1884 Zeil and features professional timekeeping with an integrated chip.
course_highlights: Challenging course through the Haßberge Nature Park, almost entirely on paved forest paths
Route over Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe and past the Seven Lakes
Aid stations every 5 km with mineral water, tea, isotonic drinks, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the Setzbachbrunnen in the Zeil am Main running park. Timekeeping with an integrated chip. Marathon runners can switch to the half-marathon course after one lap. Parking is available at the indoor swimming pool and school car parks, as well as the Tuchanger car park, with a city bus transfer. Race number collection is at the school on Friday evening and Saturday morning. Showers and changing facilities are available in the school gym. There is no baggage storage in the start/finish area. Free buses run every 5 minutes from the school building to the start line. The course runs almost entirely along paved forest paths in the Haßberge Nature Park. Aid stations are available every 5 km. Race numbers include a chip. Parking is available at the indoor swimming pool and school car park, and showers and changing facilities are available in the school gym. Medals are awarded to all participants after the race, and a free bus transfer is available.

name: ILM – Ich lauf mit gegen Gewalt
1. Volkslauf Seelze
description: The ADAC Marathon Hannover offers a varied running experience with distances from 4 to 42 km, including the marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 10 km run and handbike marathon. The course is one of the flattest in Germany, with just 19 m of elevation difference, making it ideal for fast times. The event combines an urban atmosphere, modern music and green stretches, taking runners through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied programme of events featuring an expo, Power Party and finisher celebration.
course_highlights: Flat course with just 19 m of elevation difference
Route through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks
A range of distances from 4 to 42 km, including relay and handbike events
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Marathon Expo over marathon weekend. The course is very flat and therefore ideal for fast times. Live tracking is available via the ADAC Marathon app. Massage facilities and showers are available. The programme includes the ROSSMANN Power Party, the expo and a finisher party at the brewery. Free public transport on the event day is included. Information about the course, registration, results and photos is available on the event website. The race is part of a broad Laufpass programme featuring a variety of events in the Hannover region.

name: Bremer Kuhcross QX
description: The Kuhcross is a challenging and varied cross-country race organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on demanding terrain and enjoy the ultimate cross-country experience. The event traditionally takes place in Bremen in November and attracts cross-country enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: Challenging and varied cross-country terrain
A traditional event in Bremen
Organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen
additional: The race is open to children, young people and active runners, with various categories and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Geislinger Volkslauf
description: The Geislingen Volkslauf is a long-established running event held annually in Geislingen. It offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages, including student races and an integration run. The course starts at the Schlossparkhalle and is known for its varied, well-organized route. The event is popular in the region and is hosted by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V.
course_highlights: Start at the Schlossparkhalle Geislingen
Student race for all school grades
Inclusion run for inclusive participation
additional: The Volkslauf takes place on Sunday, 15 November 2026. There are student races and an integration run. The event is organized by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V. The start is at 10:30 a.m. at the Schlossparkhalle. Runners can register online until 12 November 2025; the event includes children’s, youth, open and masters competitions.

name: itdesign-Nikolauslauf Probelauf
description: The itdesign Nikolauslauf in Tübingen is a traditional half marathon organized by Post-SV Tübingen since 1976. The course is officially measured and recognized as a road race, making it eligible for ranking lists. The route runs along finely graveled forest paths and paved sections with moderate climbs, and water, tea, and special sports drinks are available at several refreshment stations. A high-quality technical shirt is included in the entry fee for all participants and can be collected at the runners’ expo. In addition to the main race, there is also a 10 km school competition and a virtual 10 km race.
course_highlights: Officially measured half marathon (21.1 km), eligible for ranking lists
Finely graveled forest paths and approx. 8.5 km of paved paths
Maximum elevation difference approx. 82 meters; total elevation gain approx. 300 meters
additional: Refreshments at kilometers 5, 11, and 17 with water, tea, and UltraSports products; finish refreshments with raisin rolls, water, UltraRefresher, and hot tea; start and finish at Waldhäuser Straße 120, 72076 Tübingen, near the runners’ expo; runners’ expo and race office in the sports hall of Geschwister-Scholl-Schule; free Nikolauslauf app for current information and race bib management; high-quality technical shirt included in the entry fee, with the option to exchange it at the runners’ expo; shirts for virtual 10 km participants are shipped within Germany only. The test run takes place on November 16, 2025, is free, and requires no registration; run in groups with pacers; parking available at Geschwister-Scholl-Schule; finish refreshments with pretzels and vegetable broth; no shower facilities on site.

name: Jetzendorfer Hobby Crosslauf
description: The Jetzendorf Hobby Cross-Country Run is a local cross-country event held at LOWA Stadium in Jetzendorf, Bavaria. Organized by TSV Jetzendorf, the event takes place in November and offers various distances for different age groups. It is aimed at recreational runners, families, and club athletes, and is now in its 17th edition. In addition to the running races, there is also a Nordic walking course suitable for beginners and recreational walkers.
course_highlights: Cross-country running at LOWA Stadium Jetzendorf
Distances from 650 m to 5.8 km
Nordic walking course, approx. 2.9 km
additional: The program includes an 800 m stadium cross-country race for younger children, approx. 1,600 m for older children and teenagers, and the main race of approx. 5.8 km for older teenagers and adults. The event takes place in the morning in November. Typical November weather, with temperatures of approx. 7 °C and frequent rain, is to be expected. Several running distances and a Nordic walking option make the event ideal for families and recreational runners. The event takes place in November at LOWA Stadium.

name: Kreis Herbst Waldlauf Meisterschaften
description: The District Autumn Forest Running Championships take place on 15 November 2026 in Usingen/Merzhausen. This event is part of the traditional competitions organised by the HLV Hochtaunus District and gives runners in various age groups the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course winds through autumnal woodland and promises a varied, nature-filled running environment. The championships are an important fixture in the regional athletics calendar and support the development of young athletes.
course_highlights: Run through autumnal woodland
Nature-filled cross-country course
Event in Usingen/Merzhausen
additional: Weather-dependent event in November; no fixed distances for all categories; regional event with several participating clubs

name: Lila-Eule-Cross
description: The 37th Lila-Eule-Cross in Kappeln is a long-running cross-country race on the Schlei that is very popular with runners. At the most recent edition, 308 runners reached the finish, setting a participation record. The course is known for its autumn atmosphere and for being less muddy than in previous years, making the race especially appealing. The event is organised by the Schleswig-Holstein Athletics Association and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country race on the Schlei
Autumn atmosphere and strong performances
Less muddy course than in previous years
additional: Cross-country race on a varied course along the Schlei, including children’s and youth races, with a focus on autumn weather and state championships.

name: Offenbacher Behörden- und Volkswaldlauf
price_range: Erwachsene 6,00 EUR, Jugendliche U18/U20 3,00 EUR, U10-U16 1,00 EUR, Nachmeldung 2,00 EUR
description: The Offenbach Authorities and Volkswald Run is a traditional running event that has taken place annually since 1972. The race is open to municipal employees, company sports participants and guest runners, who compete on forest paths in Offenbach am Main. The course is 100% forest paths, with the start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. In addition to individual events, there are team classifications, with trophies for the winners. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers shower and changing facilities as well as free refreshments after the finish.
course_highlights: Course consists entirely of forest paths
Start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings
Various distances for youth, adults and walkers
additional: The Authorities Forest Run takes place in all weather conditions. Shower and changing facilities are available at the Arbeiterwohlfahrt recreation grounds. Free tea is offered after the finish. The award ceremonies include trophies for team winners and individual events. For travel, participants are advised to use the car park at Nasses Dreieck, opposite the Stadthalle. The course consists entirely of forest paths, with the start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. Registration is open until November 6, 2025; late entries are accepted until 9:30 a.m. on race day. Free tea, changing rooms and showers are available.

name: Riegeler Crosslauf - Rund um den Michaelsberg
location: Riegel am Kaiserstuhl, Freiburg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 50th Riegeler Crosslauf - Rund um den Michaelsberg is a traditional cross-country race in Riegel am Kaiserstuhl, organized by TV Riegel. The event offers various distances for children, young people, open runners and Masters, including short cross-country and road races. The courses run around Michaelsberg and offer local runners and young athletes an excellent opportunity to gain race experience. The longest distance is 8.1 km and is open to men, women and Masters.
course_highlights: Cross-country race around Michaelsberg
Distances from 0.5 km to 8.1 km
Separate starts for children, young people, open runners and Masters
additional: The program includes children's races (520 m), youth races (840 m, 1,400 m), a 2,900 m race for older youths and adults, and the main race over 8,100 m. Typical November weather, with temperatures around 7 °C and frequent rain, is to be expected. An off-road running event in November, with typical weather conditions around 7°C, often rainy, and various distances for all age groups.

name: Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition
description: The Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition takes place in Xanten, with the 5 km race as the main distance. The race is held on an afternoon in November and promises a cross-country feel on the beach, setting it apart from a regular road race. Alongside the main distance, there are shorter 400 m races and longer 7.5 km races, offering suitable distances for both young and experienced runners. Children’s and youth races are also part of the program. The finish line for all races is at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten.
course_highlights: Cross-country feel on the beach
Distances from 400 m to 7.5 km
Finish line at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten
additional: Typical November weather, with temperatures of around 7 °C, lows of around 2 °C, and rainy weather on most days. Results are linked via RUNME.de. Children’s and youth races, a weather-dependent November event, outdoor atmosphere at Naturbad Xantener Südsee

name: Finnensturm
location: Sport- und Solepark Große Wiese, Arnsberg-Hüsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Finnensturm is an evening race in November on a joint-friendly Finnish track at the Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park in Arnsberg-Hüsten. The 1,000-metre-long and 2.50-metre-wide track has a soft, springy surface that provides a pleasant running surface, different from asphalt or synthetic tracks. The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event attracts several hundred participants each year and is ideal for a November race with a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run on a 1,000 m-long, joint-friendly Finnish track
Soft, springy surface instead of asphalt or synthetic track
The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere
additional: The Finnish track is 2.50 m wide and runs independently of the rest of the path network. It is lit from 5:00 a.m. and in the evening until 11:00 p.m. The Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park is signposted from the Hüsten exit on the A46. The event takes place on a woodchip track at the Hüsten Sports and Saline Park; in November, weather conditions can make it wet and slippery. Refreshments and showers are available on site.

name: 13. Schloss Marienburg Marathon
description: The 13th Schloss Marienburg Marathon takes place on November 21, 2026, in Nordstemmen-Adensen. This varied scenic marathon is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The course follows village streets, paved and unpaved country lanes, woodland paths, and trails, with about 560 metres of elevation gain. A special highlight is the refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg, where runners can take a break. The 21.1 km course is shaped like a figure eight, with three refreshment stations in Adensen, and offers beautiful views of the Calenberger Land and the Leinebergland in good weather.
course_highlights: Varied course featuring village streets, country lanes, woodland paths, and trails
Refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg
Figure-eight course with about 560 metres of elevation gain and views of the Calenberger Land and Leinebergland
additional: Early marathon start at 9:00 a.m. for runners who need more than 6 hours. Official electronic timekeeping. Refreshments approximately every 5 km, including water, tea, isotonic drinks, cola, fruit, and gingerbread. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and baggage storage in the start/finish area. German Red Cross medical service in the start/finish area and along the course. Participant limit: 550 runners, including a maximum of 300 half-marathon runners. Hilly course with trails, 560 metres of elevation gain, scenic views, aid stations every 5 km.

name: 4. Heartbeat Ultra
description: Heartbeat Ultra is a participatory charity ultrarun in Fulda, taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants run laps of approximately 6 km, covering up to 112 km, and decide for themselves when to start, take breaks and finish their run. Each lap raises donations for children with half a heart, supporting research and quality of life. The event is open to everyone, from beginners to ultrarunners, and wheelchair users are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 6 km in Sportpark Johannisau, Fulda
Charity laps covering up to 112 km
Flexible start and running time between 06:00 and 21:00
additional: This is a charity run where every lap counts and the entry fee is donated in full. Participants receive a personal fundraising page where supporters can donate for each lap completed. There is a 400-metre children's run in the stadium, with each lap counted. The event is also available virtually, so people can take part from anywhere in the world. Flexible running time, virtual participation, donations for children with heart defects, registration with a personal fundraising page, medal for the first 1,500 participants.

name: 50. See-Park-Lauf
description: The 50th Bad Gandersheim See-Park Run is a traditional road race held in late November in Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark. Organized by SVG GW Bad Gandersheim, it offers categories for various age and performance groups, including boys, girls, men, women, juniors, open runners, and masters up to 95+. The event is closely connected with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, whose students and teachers take part and support the organizing team. After the race, results, personalized certificates, and a photo gallery are published online.
course_highlights: Road race around the grounds of Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark
Separate categories for a range of age and performance groups
Strong connection with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, with active participation
additional: There are two distances: 400 m and 10 km. Typical November weather is expected, with daytime highs of about 7 °C and rainy days. The organizing team comprises about 50 people, supported by around 80 students and teachers. Results, certificates, and a photo gallery are published online after the race. Road race in the Seepark, distances of 400 m and 10 km, organized by the school, with rainy November weather expected.

name: Ainringer Crosslauf
description: The Ainring Cross-Country Run is a long-standing event organized by Ski-Club Ainring e.V. in the municipality of Ainring. The start and finish are on Schwimmbadstraße. The event gives runners the opportunity to test their endurance and running technique on varied cross-country courses. It is part of the club’s diverse sports program and welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Schwimmbadstraße in Ainring
Varied cross-country courses in the municipality
Long-standing running event organized by Ski-Club Ainring
additional: The race takes place in the Ainringer Moos and around the Eschlberg area; the start and finish are on Schwimmbadstraße; children’s and school races are included.

name: Blumensaatlauf
description: The Blumensaatlauf in Essen is a long-standing running event taking place on November 21, 2026, at scenic Baldeney Lake. Organized by TUSEM Essen, the race offers a fast, flat course that is ideal for personal bests. Runners can choose between a half marathon and a 10 km race, with the event welcoming both competitive athletes and recreational runners. The idyllic route along the lake creates a special atmosphere and an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course at Baldeney Lake
Half marathon and 10 km race options
Scenic running atmosphere with views of the water
additional: Run at Baldeney Lake, registration available, family-friendly, focus on personal bests

name: Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser
description: The Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser is a traditional race held at the end of the running season, taking participants through the Braunsteich nature reserve. A particular highlight is crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, which offers a picturesque view across the water. The event is for all ages, from children to seniors, who enjoy running and walking. The race is part of the Dresden District Rankings and the Niederlausitz Cup, and is officially recognized by the German Athletics Association in the walking category.
course_highlights: Crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, with views across the water
The route mainly follows public forest paths, with three short sections on quiet residential cul-de-sacs
Autumnal November atmosphere in the Braunsteich nature reserve
additional: The 5 km and 10 km routes have three short sections on public roads, which have little traffic as they are residential cul-de-sacs. The rest of the route follows moderate forest paths, some of which are cross-country style. The race is open to all age groups, and walking is also officially recognized. Participant limit of 300–500; medals for finishers; registration on site or online; free showers and changing rooms available; integrated into regional athletics.

name: Bönnigheimer Stromberglauf
description: The Bönnigheim Stromberg Run is a traditional autumn race at the foot of the Stromberg, attracting both elite and recreational runners. The event offers scenic courses through vineyards, fields, and meadows, with varied elevation and wonderful panoramic views. The 5-kilometer loop is fast and flat, while the 10-kilometer distance features challenging climbs and an encouraging atmosphere. The race takes place around the Strombergkeller and is known for its lively atmosphere and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop with just 20 meters of elevation gain through fields and residential areas
Challenging 10 km course with 60 meters of elevation gain and panoramic views over vineyards
2 km schoolchildren’s race around the Strombergkeller, mostly on paved paths
additional: Registration is through the raceresult service provider. Special awards are available for schools, companies, and cultural associations, with attractive prizes such as a case of wine from the Strombergkeller. The course is mostly paved and offers a varied challenge, with around 70 meters of elevation gain per lap. Participants without a stated time will be placed in the final starting block. The event is organized by LG Neckar-Enz with support from the City of Bönnigheim. Distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 2 km; cultural activities; children’s and youth races; online registration

name: Crossmeisterschaft SC Magdeburg
description: The SC Magdeburg Cross Country Championships is a traditional cross-country running competition organized by SC Magdeburg and the City of Magdeburg in Saxony-Anhalt. As a championship cross-country race in the German athletics calendar, it offers a challenging off-road course that differs from classic track races. The event is part of the DLV system, with official entries, rules, and timing, and is supported by the volunteer club and federation culture. The races take place in November, typically in cool and rainy weather, offering an authentic cross-country experience for club and federation runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country course, not on a track
Distances: 700 m and 1.4 km
Event held as part of the German athletics calendar
additional: The event is officially listed in the DLV system, with entries, rules, and timing. Typical November weather is cool (7 °C, low of 2 °C) and rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The start location is in Magdeburg; detailed directions are available. Cross-country course, distances of 700 m and 1.4 km, held in November in rainy weather

name: Int. Brubbellauf
description: The International Brubbellauf in Wallenborn is a long-standing running event organised annually by SV Wallenborn. It takes place in November and is open to runners of all ability levels; beginners are also very welcome. The event has a friendly atmosphere, and late entries are accepted until 30 minutes before each start. Results and certificates are available in the “Information” section of the website.
course_highlights: Route through the centre of Wallenborn
A varied programme for all ages and ability levels
On-site late entries available
additional: Late entries are accepted on site until 30 minutes before each start. Distances range from 200 m to 10.2 km, including children’s races, a fun run, a corporate run and walking. The event takes place in mild November weather, with average temperatures of 2–7°C, and is suitable for families, beginners and ambitious runners.

name: Kalmit-Berglauf
description: The Kalmit Mountain Run is a challenging mountain race in Maikammer, Germany, covering 8.3 km with an elevation gain of 505 metres. The race starts at the market square and finishes at the summit of the Kalmit, making it a special experience in the Palatinate. The event is organised by TV 1847 Maikammer - Alsterweiler e.V. and is part of the Palatinate Mountain Running Cup. The challenging course follows asphalt and country roads and is open to various age groups, including youth, senior and masters categories.
course_highlights: Course: 8.3 km with 505 m of elevation gain
Start at the market square, finish at the Kalmit summit
Part of the Palatinate Mountain Running Cup
additional: Course: asphalt, local roads and state roads; participation open to youth, senior and masters categories; online registration until 21.11.2025; on-site registration available; start at 14:15; finish at 15:45.

name: Kunstweglauf Rednitzhembach
description: The Kunstweglauf in Rednitzhembach is organised by the endurance sports club PowerBärs Rednitzhembach e.V. and will take place for the 18th time in 2026. The event brings art and sport together in a unique symbiosis and is centred around the school building in Rednitzhembach, which offers excellent facilities including changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The start and finish are right in front of the school, creating a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators. The race is an established event in the region south of Nuremberg and offers a friendly, sporty experience in November.
course_highlights: Start and finish directly in front of the school building in Rednitzhembach
Excellent facilities including changing rooms, showers and the school café
A running event that brings art and sport together
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day up to 60 minutes before the respective start. The event takes place in and around the school building, which serves as its hub, with an assembly hall for the awards ceremony and refreshments. The event also includes results, race information and photos, and is a creative blend of art and running fun in Rednitzhembach.

name: Lindenseelaufserie
location: Rüsselsheim am Lindensee, Groß-Gerau, Hesse, Germany
description: The Lindenseelauf Series in Rüsselsheim at Lindensee is a traditional annual running event. It offers runners of various ages and ability levels the opportunity to run on attractive routes around Lindensee. The series is known for its friendly atmosphere and varied course. The event is organized by LG Rüsselsheim and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Running routes around picturesque Lindensee
Varied course for different age groups
Friendly, sporting atmosphere
additional: Races in November and January; no series standings in November and January; certificates for the top three in each age group and for teams; awards ceremony after the race

name: Lipperland Marathon
description: The Lipperland Marathon in Dörentrup offers a friendly, family atmosphere without crowds along the roads. The event is known for its straightforward organization and takes place in the beautiful Lipperland region in autumn. Runners can look forward to great views and a pleasant atmosphere in Humfeld. The event is organized by TuS Humfeld 1911 e.V. and is aimed at all participants looking for a personal running experience.
course_highlights: Marathon in a family-friendly setting
Beautiful Lipperland region in autumn with great views
No crowds along the roads
additional: The course runs through hilly terrain; start at the Humfeld sports hall; family-friendly; includes half-marathon and loop-course options; registration by bank transfer

name: Nussdorflauf
description: The Nussdorf Run is a traditional running event in Nussdorf near Eberdingen, held annually in November. The event offers various competitions for all age groups, from Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to beginner and panoramic runs, as well as Nordic walking. All participants receive a medal and certificate after crossing the finish line, and some also receive trophies or cash prizes. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the broad support of sponsors and volunteers.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400 m to 10 km
10 km panoramic run with age-group categories for all ages
Courses for Bambini, schoolchildren, teenagers and adults
additional: Late registration is possible on race day from 10:30 a.m. at the Nussdorf community hall, up to 30 minutes before the respective start. All participants receive a medal and certificate. Trophies and cash prizes are awarded to places 1–3 in various categories. Registration for the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races is handled through the schools. Various race distances; registration opens on 01.09.2025; participation conditions, results and photos available online.

name: Rhädenlauf
description: The Rhädenlauf takes place on November 21, 2026, in the Rhäden Nature Reserve in Wildeck-Obersuhl. The race is organized by TV 1888 Obersuhl and is part of the 2026 competition year. The event is for runners who want to experience a nature-rich route through a protected landscape. Timing has been provided by a modern ALGE system since 2022, ensuring precise results.
course_highlights: Run through the Rhäden Nature Reserve
Nature-rich and scenic route
Modern ALGE timing system in use since 2022
additional: Timing is provided by an ALGE system, including a start trigger with an integrated flash (E-Start). The department head is Luisa Wunn, who can be reached at 0177 4691132. Club training takes place on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays from 17:30 to 19:00 at the stadium or the Obersuhl indoor sports hall. Route through the nature reserve, training plans for participants

name: Ring Running Series 2026
description: The Ring Running Series at Hockenheimring offers a unique running experience on November 21, 2026, on an officially measured Formula 1 circuit suitable for personal bests. The flat, fully paved course follows the legendary Grand Prix circuit, featuring highlights such as the Motodrom, the Bernie Ecclestone Curve and the South Curve. Participants can choose between the half marathon and marathon and benefit from a secured course, high-quality refreshments and professional timing. The event combines a motorsport atmosphere with an athletic challenge and is ideal for runners looking for a special course and fast times.
course_highlights: Officially measured course with an AIMS certificate, suitable for personal bests
Flat, fully paved race track with long straights
Passes all the highlights of Hockenheimring, including the Motodrom and Bernie Ecclestone Curve
additional: Race number collection on site on November 20 and 21, with a personalised race number and integrated timing chip. Changing facilities in the pit lane, medical support along the course, high-quality refreshments on the course and at the finish, baggage storage near the finish, jacket drop-off in the start area with collection near the finish, free parking and shower facilities. The finish is on the original Formula 1 finish line. Schedule: marathon start 10:00, half-marathon start 11:00, course closes at 16:00, awards ceremony at 13:30. The event offers live tracking, race number collection, accommodation options at Seehotel Ketsch and a unique atmosphere that motivates runners to achieve personal bests.

name: Rurbrückenlauf
location: SIG Combibloc Systems, Linnich, Düren, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: 12.5 km, 11.5 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Rurbrückenlauf is a running series in Linnich, starting and finishing at SIG Combibloc Systems. Various distances are offered for children, young people, and adults. Adults can choose between a flat 5.2 km run and an 11.5 km run with a rolling profile that offers a little more variety. The event takes place in November and is aimed at runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at SIG Combibloc Systems in Linnich
Flat 5.2 km run for a straightforward, flat course
11.5 km run with a rolling profile for more variety
additional: The event includes distances from 0.5 km to 12.5 km, including races for children and young people. Typical November weather in Linnich is around 7 °C, with rainy days and an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Distances: 0.5 km, 1 km, 1.5 km, 4.9 km, 11.5 km, 12.5 km; start and finish at SIG Combibloc Systems; November weather: around 7 °C, rainy; event for all ages.

name: Schwollener Crosslauf - 2. Lauf der 17. OIE Nahecrosslaufserie
location: Schwollen, Landkreis Bad Kreuznach, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Schwollen Cross-Country Run is the second race in the 17th OIE Nahe Cross-Country Series and offers runners a varied cross-country course in the Schwollen region. The series is known for its friendly atmosphere and gives participants the opportunity to take part in several races to receive a series gift. The event is supported by dedicated volunteers and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The races take place at various sports grounds and in natural surroundings, which is what makes the series special.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in natural surroundings near Schwollen
A range of distances for children, middle-distance and long-distance runners
Part of the long-standing Nahe Cross-Country Series, with several stages
additional: Every participant who takes part in at least 4 races in the series receives a series gift (sports socks for middle-distance and long-distance runners). Sock size is requested during registration. Registration is online via the website. After a weather-related cancellation, a replacement date was set for another race in the series. The series includes several dates at different locations in the region. Dates at different locations, registration including sock size, series scoring, weather-related schedule changes, series gift for participants.

name: Stadtwerke Night Run
description: The Stadtwerke Night Run in Sindelfingen is the perfect event to end the 2026 running season and get participants in the mood for Christmas. Runners wear headlamps on an illuminated course, making for a special running experience in the dark. A varied programme of events for all age groups ranges from the Glühwürmchenlauf for the youngest participants and school races to 5 km and 10 km races. The event winds down in the Winterdörfle, with Swedish fires creating a festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run with a headlamp on illuminated courses
Events for children, school students and adults
Wind down in the Winterdörfle with Swedish fires
additional: The event is subject to an entry fee. Events are offered for various age groups: the Stadtwerke Glühwürmchenlauf for the youngest participants, the Kreissparkassen school races, the Wohnstätten 5 km race and the Stadtwerke 10 km race. The course is illuminated, and runners wear headlamps. The event winds down in the Winterdörfle with Swedish fires. Run with a headlamp on an illuminated course; various events for children and school students; finish in the Winterdörfle by fire pits.

name: Werler Straßenlauf
description: The Werl Road Race is a long-standing running event taking place for the 36th time on November 21, 2026. With distances for Bambini, recreational runners, and ambitious athletes, it offers a wide range of running options. The event marks the final stretch of the DJK competition year and welcomes runners of all abilities to run together with heart. It takes place amid the autumn atmosphere of Werl and combines sporting ambition with a sense of community.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from short routes to 10 kilometers
Suitable for Bambini, recreational runners, and ambitious athletes
Long-standing event with a 36-year history
additional: Distances for Bambini, recreational runners, and athletes; takes place on November 21, 2026; ideal for fast times and personal bests

name: Berliner Mannschaftslauf - einzeln oder als Team
FLVW Crossmeisterschaften
location: Schloß Neuhaus, Paderborn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

name: Memmelsdorfer Schlosslauf
description: The Memmelsdorf Castle Run is a longstanding running event held annually in Memmelsdorf since 1985. The event offers various race distances around Seehof Palace, with community and the beautiful setting at its heart. Participants of all ages are warmly invited to explore the varied routes in and around the palace and enjoy sport together.
course_highlights: Runs around Seehof Palace
Various distances for all age groups
Scenic routes through the palace park and surrounding forests
additional: Multiple race distances, including Bambini, junior races and a fun run; registration and detailed information on the website; the event takes place in late November.

name: Wilscher Geburtstags-Etappen-Marathon
description: The VfR Wilsche-Neubokel Birthday Stage Marathon is a special group run that annually honors all runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. Participants run together at a moderate pace of 6:00 to 6:15 minutes per kilometer and can join at various refreshment stops. At these stage points, the birthday celebrants treat the runners to culinary delights, making the run a unique and enjoyable experience. The event combines sporting camaraderie with a festive atmosphere and is a cherished club tradition.
course_highlights: Group run at a pace of 6:00–6:15 min/km
Refreshment stops approximately every 5–10 km, with a 10-minute break
You can join at any refreshment stop
additional: The run honors all fellow runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. The birthday celebrants lovingly prepare the refreshments at the stage points. Recent photos from the run are available via an external Flickr link. Group run, approx. 6:00–6:15 min/km; registration via an external link

name: WMF BKK AST Süßen Herbstlauf
description: The WMF BKK AST Süßen Autumn Run is a long-established running event held annually in Süßen. It offers main races over 5 km and 11 km, a 1.8 km youth race, and a 5 km walking route. The event takes place at the Kultur- und Sporthalle Süßen, which is open from 11:00 a.m. into the evening. The Autumn Run welcomes runners of all ability levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main races over 5 km and 11 km
1.8 km youth race
5 km walking route
additional: The venue is the Kultur- und Sporthalle Süßen, open from 11:00 a.m. until the evening. Races are available for different age and ability groups, along with a walking route. The event is part of AST Süßen’s club life. Courses are not officially measured; on-site registration is available; bibs use transponder timing; various running and walking options are offered for all age groups.

name: Winterlaufserie TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen – 1. Lauf
description: Die Winterlaufserie des TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung im Weidelsburgstadion in Wolfhagen-Ippinghausen. Sie umfasst mehrere Läufe mit Distanzen von 310 m bis 15 km auf befestigten und geteerten Waldwegen. Die Serie richtet sich an alle Altersklassen und bietet eine Einzel- und Mannschaftswertung mit Urkunden und Auszeichnungen. Die Veranstaltung ist vom Hessischen Leichtathletik-Verband genehmigt und legt Wert auf faire Bedingungen, beispielsweise ist das Tragen von Spikes nicht erlaubt.

name: Freiberger Adventslauf
description: The Freiberger Advent Run takes place on November 28, 2026, in the festively decorated city center of Freiberg, combining sporting activity with the special atmosphere of the run-up to Christmas. The event is a regional highlight, with several races for different age groups and distances. It attracts many runners every year and offers a festive setting with musical accompaniment, including the barrel drummers “Blechlawine” at Schlossplatz. Registration opens in June 2026 and is in high demand due to the limit of 1,000 pre-registrations.
course_highlights: Festively decorated city center of Freiberg
Musical accompaniment from the barrel drummers “Blechlawine” at Schlossplatz
Various race distances from 1 km to 12 km, including a relay
additional: Race number pickup from 12:00 at Rüleinsporthalle; late entries and changes are possible until 1 hour before the start. All races start at Café Hartmann. Start times: Bambini Run 15:00, 1 km Children's Run 15:15, 3 km Teen Run 15:30, 6 km Fun Run 15:45, 12 km Main Run and relay 16:30. Limit of 1,000 pre-registrations. Registration opens in June 2026; late entries are possible on race day. Start times: Bambini Run at 15:00, Children's Run at 15:15, Teen Run at 15:30, Fun Run at 15:45, Main Run at 16:30.

name: Mesumer Adventslauf
description: The Mesum Advent Run is a long-established running event in Rheine, offering various distances from 1 to 10 kilometres. More than 660 runners took part in the 37th edition in pleasant temperatures and sunshine. The event attracts a broad range of participants, including many athletes from Laufgemeinschaft Emsdetten, who achieved excellent results in various age groups. The race offers an appealing competition during Advent for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Races over 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
More than 660 finishers
Top placings in various age groups
additional: The race takes place in cool temperatures and usually sunny weather. The event includes several distances suitable for young people and children. Laufgemeinschaft Emsdetten is strongly represented and supports the event. Races in Rheine-Mesum, family-friendly, flat courses, races for children and young people

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Reichenbach near Lahr/Black Forest is a DLV-sanctioned race eligible for rankings, with distances of 5 km and 10 km. The course follows a 2 x 5 km loop over paved and forest paths, mostly flat with gentle climbs. The start and finish are beside the Schutter, near the Geroldseckerhalle. There is also a 5.5 km walking route through the forest and local districts, offering beautiful views of Hohengeroldseck Castle.
course_highlights: 2 x 5 km loop over paved and forest paths
Flat course profile with gentle, short climbs
Walking route with views of Hohengeroldseck Castle
additional: The 5.5 km walking event starts at 14:10 near the finish area. Based on experience, the start area for the 5 km and 10 km races is very cramped, so arriving early is recommended. The walking route passes historic and scenic points. Courses over paved and forest paths; start and finish beside the Geroldseckerhalle; limited parking; arriving early is recommended.

name: Villmarer Dorflauf
description: The Villmar Village Run is a long-standing race held in Villmar at the end of November. Races are offered over 5 km and 10 km, and young people may also take part in the adult races. The course is flat, and all events finish in the same area. Children’s and youth races are also held; further details are provided in the official race announcement. Now in its 33rd edition, the race is a fixture on the local running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat course
All adult races finish in the same area
Children’s and youth races in addition to the main programme
additional: The 5 km run and 5 km walk start first, followed by the 10 km run. Typical November weather in Villmar is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. The race takes place in November; exact details about registration and participation are available in the official race announcement.

name: Volksbank WeinstadtCross mit DM Cross und Deutschem Cross Cup
description: Der Volksbank WeinstadtCross ist ein traditionsreicher Crosslauf, der am 29. November 2026 in Weinstadt stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung umfasst am Samstag Schulmeisterschaften, Kinder- und Jugendläufe sowie den JedermannCross, während am Sonntag die Deutschen Crossmeisterschaften ausgetragen werden. Die anspruchsvolle Strecke führt querfeldein über unebenes Gelände, durch Matsch und steile Anstiege und bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern aller Alters- und Leistungsklassen ein echtes Lauferlebnis. Der WeinstadtCross ist Teil des Deutschen Cross Cups und zieht Teilnehmer aus ganz Deutschland an.

name: Christmas Run To Tree
description: The Christmas Run To Tree is an atmospheric forest run in Klövensteen Forest near Hamburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km or 12 km. The run combines sporting activity with the special experience of buying a Christmas tree. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Forest run through scenic Klövensteen Forest
Choice of 6 km or 12 km distance
Race bib in the shape of a Christmas tree
additional: Race packet pickup on event day from 09:00 to 11:15. The race bib is in the shape of a Christmas tree and must be worn visibly on the chest. Bag drop-off is available with the coupon on the race bib. Late entries are not possible. Participant transfers are possible for a fee until November 25. Awards ceremony for the 6 km at 11:15 and for the 12 km at 13:00. The event includes race bib pickup, certificates, Christmas activities, and a festive atmosphere.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Schiffenberger Wald, Giessen, is a flat running event held annually in November. It offers 5 km and 10 km races for adults, as well as races for children and young people. The event is ideal for runners looking for a fast, flat course in a natural setting. The start and finish are at the same location; exact details are available through RUNME Premium. The run takes place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, and starts at 10:15 a.m.
course_highlights: Flat course in Schiffenberger Wald
5 km and 10 km distances for adults
Races for children and young people
additional: The start and finish are the same for all races. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium. There are also 5 km walking and Nordic walking events. Results are usually published on the RUNME results page shortly after runners finish. The event is for adults, children, and young people, with start times in the morning. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium.

name: Adventslauf SV Weiden e.V.
description: The SV Weiden e.V. Advent Run is a traditional, family-friendly fun run that has been held for more than three decades on the first Sunday of Advent in the Fuchswald forest near the sports grounds in the Rottweil region. The varied course runs mostly along forest and farm tracks and offers runners of all abilities an enjoyable running experience. Alongside the main race and middle-distance race, there are also children’s races and a little ones’ race, making the event suitable for the whole family.
course_highlights: Course runs mostly along forest and farm tracks
Main race: 10.7 km; middle-distance race: 5.9 km
Children’s races and a little ones’ race on the sports field and field paths
additional: The Advent Run is open to Nordic walkers, recreational runners and competitive runners. Numerous training plans are available to help participants prepare. More than 200 runners take part, and the children’s races attract 28 children and young people. The 350 m little ones’ race takes place on the sports field. The courses are close to nature and family-friendly, with Nordic walking options.

name: Argenthaler Quarzit Adventstrail
description: The Argenthaler Quarzit Advent Trail is a trail-running event taking place on November 29, 2026, in Argenthal in the Hunsrück. The race gives runners the opportunity to experience the winter scenery of the Soonwald on a challenging course. The event is organized by LLG Hunsrück, which has hosted this festive trail adventure during Advent for more than a decade. The event is known for its festive atmosphere and scenic route through winter landscapes.
course_highlights: Route through the Soonwald in the Hunsrück
Festive atmosphere during Advent
Scenic winter landscapes
additional: The race is known for its festive atmosphere and Christmas-themed supporting program. The exact course distance is not specified, but the event is a popular winter and Advent race for trail runners.

name: Bertlicher Straßenläufe
description: The Bertlich Road Races in Herten are a traditional running event taking place on November 29, 2026. The event offers distances from 850 meters up to the marathon on flat, paved routes around Bertlich, ideal for runners of all ability levels. Participants can register in person on race day and benefit from refreshment stations, certificates, and medals. The event is family-friendly and features a pleasant supporting program in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Distances from 850 meters to 30 kilometers
Flat, paved routes through a local recreation area
Varied supporting program with refreshments and certificates
additional: Registration is open until September 27, 2024; late registration is available online until race day. Start and finish near the sports field on Heinrich-Obenhaus-Straße. Parking is available at Marktkauf Herten. Changing and shower facilities are available on site. Finishers receive certificates and medals.

name: FORD Advent-Lauf
location: Leinpfad, Daarler Brücke, Saarbrücken, Saarland, Germany
description: The FORD Advent Run is a traditional road race held in late November in Saarbrücken, on the Leinpfad at Daarler Brücke. It is part of the Sparkassen City Run Series and offers a range of distances—10 km, 5 km and 2 km—for experienced runners, beginners and children. The event is organised by SV GO! Saar 05 Leichtathletik e.V., with support from SparkasseSB, Ford and LottoSaartoto. Registration is through meisterchip.de, and the courses are officially measured, allowing results to qualify for rankings.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Leinpfad at Daarler Brücke in Saarbrücken
Part of the Sparkassen City Run Series
2 km, 5 km and 10 km distances for different groups of runners
additional: Typical November weather, with an average temperature of 7 °C, lows of around 2 °C and rainy days. The race is listed in the German running calendar system, and the courses are officially measured. The race takes place in Saarbrücken, with the start and finish on the Leinpfad at Daarler Brücke. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and is a great opportunity to kick off the Advent season with some exercise.

name: Friedeholz Cross
description: The Friedeholz Cross is a traditional forest cross-country race in Syke, Lower Saxony, and part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series. On November 29, 2026, races will be held over various distances, from a 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race to the 10.3 km main race, for children, young people, and adults. The course runs mostly on forest trails, with a short asphalt section before the finish at Waldstadion Syke. The event offers a varied cross-country running experience in an autumn setting and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Mostly forest trails with only approx. 100 m of asphalt
Start and finish at Waldstadion Syke
Part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series, with several distances
additional: Four distances on race day: 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 3.6 km middle distance for U16 and older, and 10.3 km main race for U20 and older. The event is part of a series of three races, with series scoring for those who register before the first race. Switching between the middle and long distances is possible, but does not count as a series switch. Forest trails, cross-country running, series scoring, registration required for series scoring, limited shower and changing facilities at Waldstadion Syke

name: Lorsbacher Winterlauf- und Walkingserie
location: Langenhainer Wald, Hofheim-Lorsbach, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The Lorsbach Winter Running and Walking Series is a long-standing series in the Langenhain Forest near Hofheim-Lorsbach, held on five Sundays during the winter months. Participants can choose between 10 km and 20 km routes, which are permanently signposted and can also be used for walking or hiking. The start is free, there is no timing, and the event is all about running together without a competitive element. On running Sundays, participants are served tea at a refreshment station, and coffee and biscuits are available in the sports hall after the run. At the final event, soup, wheat beer, coffee and cake are also served.
course_highlights: Permanently signposted 10 km route in the Langenhain Forest
An additional loop for the 20 km route is signposted from late November to mid-February
Hot tea available at the refreshment station near the Bahai’i forest car park (approx. km 6.4)
additional: Starts are individual, with no timing. No registration is required. Participation is free, with voluntary donations welcome. Changing rooms in the sports hall at Schinderwald are open on Sundays from 8:00 to 13:00. Coffee and biscuits are available after the run; at the final event, soup and wheat beer are also served. Bring your own collapsible cup for tea. Route profiles are available on Komoot. Routes: 10 km and 20 km; challenging and varied routes; no timing; individual starts; GPS track via Komoot; tea station with tea, coffee, biscuits, soup, wheat beer, coffee and cake; changing rooms in the sports hall; parking at the sports field and Park & Ride; no registration required.

name: Pfungstädter Advents-Crosslauf
description: The Pfungstädter Advent Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country event reaching its 57th edition in 2026. The races take place on an established course with cross-country conditions and offer appealing competitions for all age groups, from children to seniors. The event is part of the Langlaufcup and the HLV Darmstadt-Dieburg District Cross-Country Series. Staggered start times make for exciting races across various distances and age groups.
course_highlights: Cross-country course of approx. 3,700 m for the middle-distance race
Long-distance race of approx. 7,300 m over 6 cross-country laps
Sprint course of approx. 850 m for children and youth
additional: Race packets for schools will be distributed on the hard-surface court; all other participants can collect theirs in the youth room. No late entries or changes are possible on site. Start times are approximate and may be changed slightly. Online registration only, until 28.11.2025; no late entries on site; refreshments available; toilets in the Ludwig-Crössmann-Heim; no changing or shower facilities.

name: Ratzeburger Adventslauf
description: The Ratzeburg Advent Run is a traditional race around Lake Ratzeburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. The main course covers 26 kilometres, mostly on hiking trails with scenic sections and historical landmarks. There is also a 7.5 km run around Küchensee and a 1.5 km children’s run, offering an accessible introduction to running. The event combines a sporting challenge with nature and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 26 km around Lake Ratzeburg, with approx. 80% hiking trails and 20% asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the course at km 5, 10, 15, 20 and 22.5
A scenic, undulating 7.5 km route around Küchensee, plus a 1.5 km children’s run with spectator support
additional: New since 2022: split-time tracking on the 26 km course, allowing spectators and athletes to follow intermediate times. The races start at the same time, with runners lining up on the right-hand side at the start on Königsdamm. The children’s run is supported by Dein-Holzpferd.de. Routes around Lake Ratzeburg and Küchensee; online registration opens on 01.09.2026; participant limits apply to each distance; timing by Race Result.

name: Schlößlelauf - 4. Lauf der Jedermannlaufserie
description: The Schlößlelauf in Donauwörth is the fourth race in the Jedermannlauf series and offers runners of all ages and ability levels an attractive opportunity to compete. The event is organised by LG Donau-Ries and traditionally takes place in late autumn. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Donauwörth and is part of a popular running series in the region. The event promotes recreational sport and is aimed at children, young people and active runners.
course_highlights: Part of the Jedermannlauf series
Various categories for all age groups
Race in the historic town of Donauwörth
additional: Registration is by email. The event includes running and cycling events, as well as filters for terrain and sport type.

name: Schmachtendorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Schmachtendorf St. Nicholas Run is a traditional running event held in late November in Oberhausen-Schmachtendorf, organized by Spvgg. Sterkrade-Nord 1920/25 e.V. The event offers races for all age groups, from a 300-meter Bambini run to a 10 km run for adults. The course runs mostly along forest trails in Dunkelschlag and around the Buchenweg sports ground. Every participant receives a Stutenkerl, and awards are presented promptly after each race, with prizes for the top runners in each category.
course_highlights: 300-meter loop around the artificial-turf pitch on Buchenweg (Bambini run)
10 km run mostly along forest trails in Dunkelschlag
Start and finish at the Buchenweg sports ground; no traditional city-center course
additional: Electronic chip timing using the chip in the race bib, provided by TAF-TIMING. Certificates are available on the event day or online later. Parking is signposted at Heinrich Böll Comprehensive School and at the Schmachtendorfer Straße market square. Distances: 300 m Bambini run and 10 km for adults; course on forest trails and sports grounds; children’s and adult categories; November weather may be rainy.

name: Uplengener Adventslauf
description: The Uplengen Advent Run is a traditional cross-country race taking place for the 54th time. The races run through the Hollsand Nature Reserve and offer challenging courses depending on the weather. The event is one of the oldest running events in the region and is often used to prepare for cross-country championships. Various course distances give young people and adults the opportunity to achieve personal bests or improve their endurance. The Remels Primary School Friends’ Association will provide coffee and cake.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Hollsand Nature Reserve
Challenging courses depending on the weather
Various course distances for different age groups
additional: U14 runners can choose between 1450 m and 3100 m; U16 runners can take part in the 4450 m middle-distance race. The red loop is approximately 3000 m plus a 100 m start chute. The course uses a checkpoint system for route guidance. Cross-country race in the Hollsand Nature Reserve; course distances vary; registration and results online; coffee and cake from the Remels Primary School Friends’ Association.

name: Weihnachtsmarktlauf
description: The Christmas Market Run in Landstuhl is a traditional race held annually on November 30. With a 7.6 km main race and a 1.3 km students’ race, it offers a sporting challenge for various age groups. The event is organized by LLG Landstuhl e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scoring for clubs and groups. Registration is open from October 15 to November 28, and on-site registration is available.
course_highlights: 7.6 km main race
1.3 km students’ race
Age-group scoring and group competition
additional: Registration is open from October 15 to November 28. On-site registration is available. There are performance and group competitions, with prize money for the top participants and groups. The race takes place on November 30. Online registration is available, with prizes for individual and group competitions. The course runs through the festively decorated town.

name: Überruhrer Adventscrosslauf
description: The Überruhrer Advent Cross-Country Run takes place on November 29, 2026, in Essen-Überruhr. Its cross-country course takes runners through wintry nature in keeping with the Advent season. The event is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, and is held in accordance with the German Athletics Regulations (DLO). The awards ceremony and certificate distribution take place right next to the course, creating a friendly, sporting atmosphere. A catering stand in the finish area serves hot and cold drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through the natural surroundings of Essen-Überruhr
Age-group categories from U8 through seniors M/W 80
Awards ceremony and certificate distribution right next to the course
additional: Parking is available in the adjacent residential area; the recommended parking location is Marktplatz Überruhr (approx. 500 m on foot). Public transport is available via bus routes SB15, 144, 166, and 177. Catering in the finish area includes hot and cold drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The race office is located in the park. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. The race takes place on the first Sunday of Advent, in typical November weather, with temperatures around 2–7°C and frequent rain. The event is open to everyone who enjoys cross-country running and offers a friendly atmosphere, with the awards ceremony held on site.

name: Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf
description: The Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf is a popular race around the Christmas market in Wiedenbrück’s old town, illuminated for the festive season. The course is a five-lap circuit of approximately 10.2 km and has not been officially measured. The race traditionally takes place in December and offers a festive atmosphere in the town centre. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück and attracts numerous runners from the region.
course_highlights: Five-lap circuit around the Christmas market
Wiedenbrück’s old town illuminated for the festive season
Approximately 10.2 km; run clockwise
additional: Start and finish on Lange Straße in Wiedenbrück. Race-pack collection on 5.12.2025 from 15:00 at the Luise-Hensel-Saal in the Stadthaus. Online registration only, opening on 8.10.2025 at 21:00. No race-day registration. Time limit: 75 minutes. Wearing headphones or earbuds is prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants are asked to keep as far to the right as possible and not to run in groups, to allow others to lap them. Participant limit: 1,100. Online registration only. Medals can be reordered. Start on 04.12.2026.

name: /10k Rainbow Run 2026
location: Frankfurt am Main, Frankfurt City Forest, Hesse, Germany
description: The 5/10k Rainbow Run is a trail race in Frankfurt’s Goldstein City Forest, taking place on December 5, 2026. Participants can choose between one 5 km lap or two laps for 10 km. The course runs mostly on firm forest paths, with some sections on asphalt, making it suitable for both beginners and runners looking for a faster pace. The race is part of the FVV XMAS Tournament weekend and stands against homophobia in sport by promoting an open and tolerant society. The event welcomes a diverse field of runners, including queer athletes, allies, and people of all ages and backgrounds.
course_highlights: Forest course in Frankfurt’s Goldstein City Forest
Firm forest paths with some sections on asphalt
Part of the long-running FVV XMAS Tournament, with more than 30 years of LGBTIQ* sports history
additional: In addition to the run, the FVV XMAS Tournament includes a Saturday evening party, a Sunday brunch, and a city tour. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with frequent snowfall and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The FVV XMAS Tournament weekend also features social events such as a party, brunch, and city tour, and supports LGBTQ+ causes.

name: Berliner Nikolauslauf 2026
price_range: 5,00 Euro bis 30,00 Euro (je nach Kategorie und Anmeldungstermin)
description: The 2026 Berlin St. Nicholas Run is a traditional race around the picturesque Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke lakes in Berlin’s Grunewald forest. The course follows a measured 5.3-kilometre lakeside path that is popular with both recreational visitors and competitive athletes. The event offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. It takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organised by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.
course_highlights: A loop around Schlachtensee, 5.3 km per lap
A nature-rich route through Berlin’s Grunewald forest
A popular training route with top athletes and recreational visitors
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:00 a.m. at Fischerhüttenstraße 137, 14163 Berlin, near the turning circle between Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. Race-day late entries are available online, subject to an additional fee. The event offers a range of distances for runners and Nordic walkers, as well as relay races. Distances range from 330 m to 26.8 km. Registration is available online or in writing; race-day late entries are online only and subject to a fee. Race bibs can be collected in Berlin.

name: Forchheimer Nikolauslauf
description: The Forchheim Nikolauslauf is a long-standing running event hosted by LG Forchheim on the Sportinsel in Forchheim. The 46th edition takes place on December 5, 2026, and features races for children and young people, a 5.3 km fun run, and a 10 km main race. The course follows a new route heading south, with the 10 km race making four circuits around the Sportinsel. The event regularly attracts more than 600 participants and offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children’s and youth races in the morning, starting at 11:20 a.m.
5.3 km fun run on a new route heading south (4 laps)
10 km main race with four laps around the Sportinsel
additional: Start times: children’s and youth races from 11:20 a.m., 5.3 km fun run at 1:00 p.m., 10 km main race at 2:00 p.m. The 5.3 km course is run four times heading south; the 10 km course is run four times around the Sportinsel. Various race categories, festive atmosphere, traditional December event, children’s and youth races, 5.3 km fun run, 10 km main race.

name: Glücksburger Nikolaus-Crosslauf
location: Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2, 24960 Glücksburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Glücksburg St Nicholas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country event held in December in Glücksburg on the Baltic Sea, organised by TSV Glücksburg 09. The races start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2. Adults and older teenagers can choose between a medium 4.1 km cross-country run and a long 8.2 km run, while younger children take part in shorter, fun runs. The event has a St Nicholas theme, with a piggyback run for parents carrying babies and various races for toddlers and young people. Every participant receives a chocolate Santa Claus as a gift.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on varied terrain by the Baltic Sea
Start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2
A range of distances from 100 m to 8.2 km for all age groups
additional: The youngest participants’ races are not timed, to preserve their fun, playful character. The event takes place in typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. It also includes volunteer duties at the start, finish and along the course, as well as refreshments including coffee, tea and cake. Registration is online, and the event takes place at Schwennau Arena in Glücksburg.

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Schnaitheim is a traditional running event held annually at Moldenberg. The event offers various distances for students, fitness runners, and trail runners, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 12 km trail run. Runners can look forward to a varied course in a sporty, family-friendly atmosphere. TSG Schnaitheim Athletics looks forward to welcoming all participants on December 5.
course_highlights: Children’s races with age-appropriate courses
5 km fitness run and walking on varied terrain
12 km trail run with sections close to nature
additional: The Nikolauslauf takes place at Moldenberg. The event is organized by TSG Schnaitheim 1874 e.V. Various race distances are available for different age and ability groups. Results and rankings from previous races are available to download. The event takes place on December 5, 2026, with course analyses, elevation details, and downloadable results. It is a popular event for runners and walkers in the region.

name: Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km
description: The Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km is an annual pre-Christmas road race in Steinfurt, Germany, held as part of the Nikolausmarkt. The race starts at the historic market square in Burgsteinfurt and finishes at the Nikolausmarkt. The course first passes through the historic old town, then follows natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area before returning to the market. Since its founding in 1975, the race has become a fixture in the local running calendar, attracting both club and recreational runners from the region.
course_highlights: Start at the historic market square in Burgsteinfurt
Route through the historic old town
Loop on natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area
additional: Typical December weather: approx. 3 °C, usually snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. 10 km race, typical December weather with possible snowfall; participants are usually local club members and recreational runners.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim (2)
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event that has taken place in Rodgau-Jügesheim since 1980, attracting both recreational runners and top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series comprises four events, each offering 5 km and 10 km distances, starting at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion. Alongside the sporting competition, community spirit is also a key focus, supported by team scoring for men’s, women’s and mixed teams. The event is easy to reach by public transport and offers professional timing with a chip attached to each race number.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion in Rodgau-Jügesheim
5 km and 10 km distances
Easy to reach by S-Bahn (S1), with only a 1 km walk from the station
additional: Team scoring is available for teams of three (men, women, mixed). Chip timing with gun-time recording by MA:XX-. The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Series dates: 1.11.2025, 6.12.2025, 3.1.2026, 7.2.2026. The series comprises several races, with team scoring also available. The routes are on paved and asphalted forest paths, which often have snow or frost in winter conditions. Training plans for various target times are offered to help runners prepare for the races.

name: MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus-Trail Pommelsbrunn
description: The MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus Trail in Pommelsbrunn offers trail running and hiking in the picturesque Hersbrucker Schweiz in the Nürnberger Land. On December 5, 2026, runners can choose from four challenging routes ranging from 10 km to a marathon, and families can take part in the Wichtel Trail. The trails are well marked and cross varied terrain with some challenging climbs, making them ideal for both ambitious runners and beginners. A free shuttle service makes getting there easier, and there are special options for trail runners with dogs.
course_highlights: Four routes from 10 km to a marathon, with challenging climbs
Well-marked trails in the Hersbrucker Schweiz
Wichtel Trail for families and special trails for runners with dogs
additional: On Saturday, December 5, 2026, the XL and L trails and the Wichtel Trail take place; on Sunday, December 6, 2026, the S and M trails take place, including options for runners with dogs. A free shuttle service runs from parking areas in Happurg to the start and finish area. The routes are fully marked, and participants receive a voucher code 14 days before the event for a free Komoot route download. Parking in Pommelsbrunn is limited, so travel by public transport is recommended. Trails with up to 1,582 meters of elevation gain, aid stations, well-marked routes, GPS downloads available.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Lage is a traditional running event organized by the running division of TG Lage. The course runs through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park and features well-maintained forest trails, partly along the famous Hermann Trail. The run is suitable for runners of all ability levels and takes place annually in December. The event is part of TG Lage’s varied running and walking program, which also offers beginner courses and training opportunities.
course_highlights: Course through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park
Well-maintained, easy-to-run forest trails
Sections along the famous Hermann Trail
additional: TG Lage’s running division also offers a Nordic walking beginner course that covers the basics in 4 sessions of 60 minutes each. Walking poles are available to borrow. There is also a 10-session pass for time-limited training participation, valid for 6 months and 10 training sessions. The office is open on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Run on forest and field paths in the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park, on the 2nd Sunday of Advent; easy to reach, with a festive atmosphere in the gym.

name: Fischteiche Cross
description: The Fischteiche Cross is a traditional cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst near Leck, organised by SV Enge-Sande. It marks the end of the Cross-Cup series and offers races for different age groups and distances, from 0.8 km for the youngest children to 9.6 km for adults and seniors. The event features a varied woodland course and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments on site.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Langenberger Forst
Distances from 0.8 km to 9.6 km, depending on age group
Varied woodland course with typical December weather
additional: Starts are organised by age group and suitable distance; registration and results via myraceresult; coffee, cake and other refreshments available on site; awards ceremony after the race. Cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst, with distances for all age groups and registration via myraceresult. Weather-dependent, with possible winter conditions, and refreshments including coffee and cake.

name: FT Jahn Nikolauslauf
location: Jahn Vereinsheim, Landsberg am Lech, Bavaria, Germany
description: The FT Jahn Nikolauslauf in Landsberg am Lech is a traditional running event held annually in December. It offers various distances for all age groups and fitness levels, from 1 km for children to 10 km for endurance runners. Nordic walking is also included. The event combines sporting ambition with a friendly community atmosphere in one of Germany’s most beautiful towns, inviting everyone to kick off the Advent season in an active way.
course_highlights: Distances from 1 km to 10 km for different age groups
Winter atmosphere in the historic town of Landsberg am Lech
Combination of running and Nordic walking events
additional: Start times are staggered by distance: the 1 km and 2 km races start at 11:00, the 5 km run and Nordic walking event at 11:30, and the 10 km run at 11:45. Minimum ages vary by distance (6 years for 1 km, 12 years for 2 km, and 16 years for 5 km and 10 km). The event takes place at the Jahn clubhouse in Landsberg am Lech. Running and Nordic walking distances from 1 km to 10 km; various age groups; winter atmosphere; registration required.

name: Heeslinger Nikolauscross
description: The Heeslingen Nikolaus Cross-Country Run is a popular cross-country race held annually in Heeslingen, Lower Saxony. The event attracts athletes and families from the region and is known for its high-level sporting challenges. The races also determine the district champions of Rotenburg/W. The organizer, Heeslinger SC, is an established point of contact for sports enthusiasts and volunteers from the surrounding communities.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through varied terrain
Determination of the district champions of Rotenburg/W.
Event in the Heeslingen region with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Courses and participation conditions are available in the relevant event announcement; no entry fee is required. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children, young people, adults and masters.

name: Ilsfelder Nikolauslauf
price_range: 6,00 € bis 12,00 € je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The Ilsfeld St. Nicholas Run is a traditional running event taking place on 6 December 2026 in Ilsfeld. The races follow scenic circular routes along the Schozach through the municipality. Whether you are a beginner or a pro, the focus here is on the enjoyment of running. In addition to individual and group entries, there is also a St. Nicholas category for runners wearing a St. Nicholas costume.
